# Tabler assets

Pinned package: `@tabler/core@1.4.0` (Bootstrap 5 UI kit).

These compiled files are served locally by the admin layout only. No Node.js build or CDN connection is required at runtime. Original copyright banners are retained.

Downloads:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.4.0/dist/css/tabler.min.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.4.0/dist/js/tabler.min.js

License notices:
- `LICENSE`: upstream Tabler MIT license, retrieved from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tabler/tabler/dev/LICENSE. Historical license URLs were unavailable; the assets retain their original 2018–2025 attribution.
- `LICENSE-bootstrap`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twbs/bootstrap/v5.3.7/LICENSE
- `LICENSE-popper`: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@popperjs/core@2.11.8/LICENSE.md

SHA-256 checksums:
```
7ef750bd10546a695d0b12767ad8048bd8f3ec5de7daefb1067f9d0daa3d1c9a  tabler.min.css
b60c76160e97624574dbb8cf10abe6aee9a6493b60096fdfc15dd1dd2bd99eb9  tabler.min.js
```

When upgrading, replace both assets together, preserve license notices, update checksums, and verify navigation at desktop and mobile widths. Source maps are not shipped; they are not needed to run the dashboard.
